capabilities: Convert HWP, HWPX, HWPML, PDF, Excel, Word and PowerPoint files to Markdown with extracted images, tables and footnotes
Batch-convert files or watch a vault folder and convert new documents automatically
Preview HWPX files and edit their paragraph, heading and table-cell text
Export a Markdown note to HWPX with official-document presets, page layout and approval box settings
Run document tools such as comparison, form filling, redaction, table extraction, OCR and RAG chunk generation
extras: Marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Desktop only. The optional OCR add-on needs a separate ~200 MB ZIP download per release, Windows x64 only, and must be reinstalled after each plugin update. Network is off by default; an optional webhook sends file name, result path and success flag to a configured URL.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to import Korean office documents like HWP and HWPX, or to produce HWPX files from Markdown notes.
summary: Document converter that turns HWP, HWPX, HWPML, PDF, Excel, Word and PowerPoint files into Markdown notes, edits HWPX, and exports Markdown to HWPX.
